name: Baked Cod with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Oven-baked cod with lemon and herbs, served with a small portion of roasted potatoes and tender green beans for a lean, satisfying dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cut potatoes into small cubes.
Toss potatoes with 5g olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on a tray for 20 minutes, turning once.
Place cod on the tray (or a second tray). Season with garlic powder, parsley, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and drizzle with remaining 5g olive oil.
Bake cod 10–12 minutes until it flakes easily; continue roasting potatoes until tender and browned.
Meanwhile, steam green beans 5–6 minutes until crisp-tender. Serve everything together with extra lemon if desired.

name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Oven-baked salmon with lemon and herbs, served with crispy roasted potatoes and tender green beans for a balanced, recovery-focused dinner.
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with half the olive oil, salt, pepper, and half the minced garlic.
Roast potatoes on a sheet pan for 25 minutes, flipping once halfway.
Add salmon to the pan, drizzle with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, remaining garlic, salt, and pepper; roast 12–14 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Meanwhile, steam or boil green beans until tender-crisp (5–7 minutes), then season with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Plate salmon with roasted potatoes and green beans; add extra lemon wedges if desired.

name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato Mash and Steamed Broccoli
description: A nutritious and flavorful dinner featuring baked salmon fillet, creamy sweet potato mash, and tender steamed broccoli, seasoned with herbs and lemon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Place the salmon fillet on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, dried herbs, salt, and pepper. Bake for 12-15 minutes until cooked through.
Peel and dice the sweet potato. Boil in salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with a fork or potato masher.
Steam the broccoli for 5-7 minutes until tender but still crisp.
Plate the salmon alongside the sweet potato mash and steamed broccoli. Drizzle any remaining lemon juice from the baking tray over the salmon.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice
description: Tender beef strips and colorful vegetables quickly stir-fried in a savory sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice—simple, satisfying, and perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, water, and cornstarch to make a quick stir-fry sauce.
Heat neutral oil in a wok or large pan over high heat; stir-fry beef 2–3 minutes until browned, then remove to a plate.
Add garlic and ginger, then stir-fry vegetables 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss 1–2 minutes until glossy; finish with sesame oil.
Serve the stir-fry over the cooked rice.

name: Beef Meatballs with Tomato Pasta
description: Lean beef meatballs served with whole wheat pasta in a rich tomato sauce and a side of steamed green beans for a classic satisfying dinner.
instructions: Mix the ground beef with breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half of the minced onion, salt, and pepper, then form into small meatballs.
Heat half of the olive oil in a pan and brown the meatballs on all sides, then lower the heat and cook through.
Cook the whole wheat pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
In a second pan, sauté the remaining onion and garlic in olive oil, add the passata and basil, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Steam the green beans until tender-crisp.
Serve the pasta with tomato sauce, beef meatballs, and green beans on the side.

name: Berry Protein Overnight Oats
description: Creamy overnight oats with Greek yogurt, whey protein, blueberries, banana, and a spoonful of almond butter for a balanced muscle-gain breakfast.
instructions: Add the rolled oats, whey protein, chia seeds, and cinnamon to a jar or bowl.
Stir in the milk and Greek yogurt until smooth and well combined.
Top with sliced banana, blueberries, and almond butter.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 6 hours.
Serve cold and stir before eating.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Rice
description: A hearty burrito bowl with juicy pan-seared chicken, fluffy cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn, salsa, and a little cheddar for a balanced, high-energy lunch.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. Fluff, then stir in chopped cilantro, a squeeze of lime, and a pinch of salt.
Season chicken with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Pan-sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 4–6 minutes per side, then rest 3 minutes and slice.
Warm the black beans and corn in the same pan for 2–3 minutes.
Assemble the bowl: rice, chicken, beans, corn, salsa, diced avocado, grated cheddar, and a dollop of Greek yogurt. Finish with extra lime if desired.

name: Chicken rice bowl with roasted vegetables
description: A balanced bowl with grilled chicken breast, steamed rice, and oven-roasted zucchini and bell pepper, finished with a light lemon herb dressing.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and toss the zucchini and bell pepper with half of the olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast the vegetables for 20 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Season the chicken breast with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then grill in a hot pan until cooked through.
Warm the rice and build the bowl with rice, roasted vegetables, and sliced chicken.
Finish with lemon juice and the remaining olive oil before serving.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowl with Broccoli
description: Pan-seared chicken glazed in a simple teriyaki-style sauce, served over rice with steamed broccoli and sesame for a satisfying training-day lunch.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions.
Steam the broccoli for 5–6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Mix soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, grated garlic and ginger, water, and cornstarch until smooth.
Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes until glossy and thick, turning chicken to coat. Slice the chicken.
Assemble the bowl: rice, broccoli, chicken, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

name: Chocolate-Banana Protein Smoothie
description: A thick, satisfying smoothie with banana, oats, soy milk, and chocolate protein—ideal for an easy protein hit between meals.
instructions: Add soy milk, banana, protein powder, oats, cocoa powder, and peanut butter to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Add ice and blend again for a thicker texture.
Taste and adjust thickness with a splash of soy milk if needed.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Apple and Walnuts
description: A simple snack bowl with cottage cheese, diced apple, toasted walnuts, and a drizzle of honey, served with oatcakes on the side.
instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant.
Dice the apple into small pieces.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with apple, toasted walnuts, honey, and cinnamon.
Serve with oatcakes on the side.

name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Almonds
description: A refreshing and protein-rich snack combining creamy cottage cheese, sweet pineapple chunks, and crunchy almonds for a quick energy boost.
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a bowl.
Top with diced pineapple and sliced almonds.
Drizzle with honey and mix gently.
Serve immediately or chill for 10 minutes for a refreshing snack.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Edamame and Vegetables
description: A classic, savory fried rice with fluffy scrambled eggs, edamame, and crisp veggies—perfect for meal prep and post-training carbs.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of pepper. Heat a large pan or wok with half the neutral oil and scramble the eggs; remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil to the pan. Sauté garlic, ginger, carrot, and peas for 2–3 minutes.
Add edamame and the cold cooked rice; stir-fry 3–4 minutes, breaking up clumps until hot.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil, then fold the scrambled eggs back in.
Finish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Garlic Shrimp with Zucchini Noodles
description: A light and flavorful dinner featuring succulent garlic shrimp served over fresh zucchini noodles, tossed in a hint of olive oil and lemon.
instructions: Spiralize the zucchini into noodles and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp to the pan, season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes, and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until pink.
Remove the pan from heat and stir in lemon juice.
In a separate pan, lightly sauté the zucchini noodles for 1-2 minutes until just tender.
Serve the garlic shrimp over the zucchini noodles.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Overnight Oats
description: Creamy overnight oats layered with Greek yogurt, berries, chia seeds, and a spoonful of almond butter for a balanced, high-protein breakfast.
instructions: Add the rolled oats, milk, chia seeds, and half of the Greek yogurt to a jar or container.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Top with the remaining Greek yogurt, blueberries, sliced banana, and almond butter before serving.
Finish with a drizzle of honey and serve chilled.

name: Grilled Chicken and Quinoa Salad
description: A hearty salad with grilled chicken breast, protein-rich quinoa, fresh vegetables, and a light lemon-olive oil dressing for a nutritious and filling lunch.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-fry for 6-7 minutes on each side until fully cooked. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
In a bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and sliced red onion.
In a small separate bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Add the sliced chicken to the quinoa and vegetable mixture.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 hours.

name: Lentil Bolognese with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
description: Hearty lentil-tomato sauce simmered with classic aromatics and served over whole wheat spaghetti—comforting, high-carb and protein-friendly.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve a splash of pasta water and drain.
Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 6–8 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, lentils, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10–12 minutes, adding a little water if needed.
Toss pasta with the sauce, loosening with reserved pasta water if necessary.
Serve topped with nutritional yeast.

name: Paneer Tikka Rice Bowl with Cucumber Raita
description: Oven-baked paneer tikka over fluffy basmati rice with a refreshing cucumber raita and crisp salad for a balanced, high-protein lunch.
instructions: Cook basmati rice according to package directions; keep warm.
Heat oven to 220°C. Toss paneer cubes, bell pepper, and red onion with olive oil, tikka spice mix, half the yogurt, lemon juice, and salt.
Spread on a baking tray and bake 12–15 minutes, turning once, until lightly charred at the edges.
Make raita: mix remaining yogurt with grated cucumber, a pinch of salt, and chopped coriander.
Assemble the bowl: rice on the bottom, paneer tikka on top, raita on the side.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal with Greek Yogurt
description: A hearty bowl of creamy oats topped with sliced bananas, rich peanut butter, and a dollop of Greek yogurt for extra protein. Drizzled with honey and sprinkled with chia seeds for added texture and nutrients.
instructions: Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Stir in rolled oats and cook over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Remove from heat and let it sit for 2 minutes.
Slice the banana and mix half into the oatmeal.
Top the oatmeal with Greek yogurt, peanut butter, remaining banana slices, honey, and chia seeds.
Stir gently before serving.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Smoothie
description: A thick, satisfying smoothie with whey, banana, oats, and peanut butter—perfect between meals to keep calories and protein on track without feeling heavy.
instructions: Add almond milk, banana, oats, whey protein, peanut butter, and cinnamon to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth (30–45 seconds). Add ice and blend again if you want it thicker.
Taste and adjust thickness with a splash more milk if needed. Drink immediately.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Juicy herb-rubbed pork tenderloin served with crispy roasted potatoes and simply sautéed green beans—classic strength-focused dinner plate.
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C/425°F. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with 10g olive oil, paprika, rosemary, salt and pepper; roast 30–35 minutes, flipping once.
Season pork with salt, pepper and rosemary. Sear in a hot pan with 5g olive oil for 2–3 minutes per side until browned.
Transfer pork to the oven (or keep in the pan if oven-safe) and roast 12–15 minutes until just cooked; rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Sauté green beans in butter with minced garlic for 5–6 minutes until bright and tender-crisp; finish with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Plate sliced pork with roasted potatoes and green beans.

name: Protein Overnight Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
description: Creamy overnight oats blended with soy yogurt and vanilla protein, topped with banana and a drizzle of peanut butter for a balanced, training-friendly breakfast.
instructions: In a bowl or jar, mix oats, soy milk, soy yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (or overnight) to thicken.
In the morning, stir well; add a splash of soy milk if you want it looser.
Top with sliced banana and drizzle peanut butter over the top.
Serve chilled (or warm gently in the microwave if preferred).

name: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon and Avocado Toast
description: A protein-packed breakfast with fluffy scrambled eggs, smoked salmon, and creamy avocado on whole-grain toast. Perfect for a balanced start to the day.
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and scramble the eggs until soft and fluffy.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices until crispy.
Mash the avocado and spread it evenly on the toasted bread. Drizzle with lemon juice.
Place the scrambled eggs on one slice of toast and top with smoked salmon. Serve with the second slice of toast on the side.

name: Smoky Tempeh Burrito Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Rice
description: A restaurant-style burrito bowl with smoky seared tempeh, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn, crunchy veg, and a tangy Greek-yogurt crema.
instructions: Slice tempeh into thin strips. Toss with soy sauce (or tamari), smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear tempeh 3–4 minutes per side until browned and smoky.
Stir lime juice, lime zest, and chopped cilantro into the warm cooked rice; season lightly with salt.
Make crema: mix Greek yogurt with a squeeze of lime juice, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Thin with 1–2 tbsp water if needed.
Assemble bowls: cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn, lettuce, tomatoes, bell pepper, avocado, and seared tempeh.
Drizzle with yogurt crema and add extra cilantro and lime if desired.

name: Spinach & Feta Egg-White Scramble with Wholegrain Toast
description: Fluffy egg-white scramble with wilted spinach and tangy feta, served with a slice of toasted wholegrain bread for a satisfying, low-carb-lean breakfast.
instructions: Toast the wholegrain bread until golden.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add spinach and cook 1–2 minutes until wilted.
Whisk egg whites with the whole egg, salt, and pepper. Pour into the pan.
Cook gently, stirring, until softly set. Crumble feta over the top and fold through for 30 seconds.
Serve the scramble with the toast on the side.

name: Spinach Ricotta Pasta Bake
description: Comforting baked pasta with ricotta, spinach, tomato sauce, and mozzarella for a satisfying vegetarian dinner with classic Italian flavors.
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until just al dente, then drain.
Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil, add the spinach, and cook until wilted.
Stir in the tomato passata, basil, and ricotta until combined into a creamy sauce.
Fold in the cooked pasta, transfer to a baking dish, and top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
description: Pan-seared salmon with glossy teriyaki sauce served over fluffy rice with steamed edamame and crisp cucumber for a balanced, hearty lunch.
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and keep warm.
Whisk soy sauce, mirin, honey, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Steam edamame for 4–5 minutes; slice cucumber and julienne the carrot.
Pan-sear salmon in neutral oil over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 30–60 seconds to glaze the salmon.
Assemble the bowl: rice, edamame, cucumber, carrot, salmon; finish with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice
description: Crisp-tender vegetables and golden tofu in a savory ginger-garlic sauce, served over jasmine rice for a satisfying, balanced dinner.
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.
Press tofu for 5 minutes, then cut into cubes. Toss with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Heat neutral oil in a wok/pan over medium-high heat. Sear tofu 6–8 minutes, turning, until golden; remove to a plate.
Add broccoli, pepper, and carrot to the pan with a splash of water. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, water, and sesame oil. Pour into the pan, add tofu back, and toss 1–2 minutes until glossy. Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve over rice.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich on Wholegrain Bread
description: Classic tuna salad with crunchy celery and a touch of yogurt-mayo, served on wholegrain bread for a protein-forward afternoon boost.
instructions: In a bowl, mix tuna, Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, finely chopped celery, salt, and pepper.
Toast the bread lightly if desired.
Pile the tuna salad onto one slice, add lettuce, and close with the second slice.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Turkey & Cheese Wholegrain Sandwich with Apple
description: A simple, satisfying sandwich with lean turkey and cheddar on wholegrain bread, paired with a crisp apple for extra carbs and fiber.
instructions: Wash and slice the tomato; rinse the lettuce.
Spread mustard on one slice of bread.
Layer turkey, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato; close the sandwich with the second slice.
Serve with the apple on the side.
